payload.location:
MALACCA STRAIT
In the precautionary
area of the Traffic
Separation Scheme
(TSS)
Malaysia
01° 17.45' N
104° 09.37' E
payload.summary:
While the tug boat towing barge was underway, the Chief
Officer noticed a sampan and two perpetrators sighted
onboard the barge. The perpetrators subsequently left the
barge and escaped in the sampan. Some scrap metal were
stolen. The crew were not injured.
The vessels continued their voyage, with the master
declaring that no assistance was required.
The incident was reported to Maritime and Port Authority of
Singapore (MPA) (flag State). Singapore Port Operations
Control Centre (POCC) confirmed that this information has
been shared with the Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN)
Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF), Singapore Police
Coast Guard (PCG) and Indonesian authority.
